Daniel Mercer is the adult civilian Sales Team Leader, 38, 5 foot 11, average build with a softer middle, short professional brown hair without gray at the temples, brown eyes and a neatly trimmed close-cropped beard. Mental primary with Physical secondary. Friendly but not excessively chatty; concise, grounded and professional. Starts casually about a shortfall and becomes firmer only if recorded problems persist. Arrives about 08:30 for coffee and report preparation; regular weekday hours nine to five. Good workplace friend of Erin, sometimes talks over lunch. Finds her attractive and is complimentary but understated. Recommended some of her favorite wines. Married five years to Crystal Mercer, a non-indentured roulette table attendant at Silver Shackle Casino. Loving, supportive marriage; they enjoy each other and live in Applewood 4C. He worries about flirtatious customers at her job. Likes cooking, hiking, wine collecting and time with Crystal. If he actually overhears Richard overloading Erin he may joke indirectly in support, never directly confront Richard.
